identity.limited_access: Limited account capabilities. Verify to unlock.

power.description: System operates on low-cost servers. Initiate donation sequence to upgrade infrastructure.

privacy.cover_traffic_desc: Background decoy messages for Maximum-privacy groups, indistinguishable from real traffic (~{{mb}} MB/day per group). Currently opted-in: {{count}}.
privacy.cover_traffic_enabled_toast: Cover traffic enabled — groups at Maximum level will emit decoy traffic.
privacy.cover_traffic_disabled_toast: Cover traffic disabled globally. No decoy messages will be sent.
privacy.panic_desc: If forced to unlock your device, entering this password will silently obliterate all local data.
privacy.dead_man_desc: Automatically destroy your account if inactive for a set period.

support.background_desc: To receive notifications when NYX is closed, we highly recommend installing the app (PWA). If using a browser, ensure it has permission to run in the background.
support.android_guide_steps: <0>🤖 Android:</0> Install app via browser menu. Then Settings > Apps > NYX (or your browser) > Battery > <1>Unrestricted</1>
support.ios_guide_steps: <0>🍎 iOS:</0> Share > Add to Home Screen. <1>iOS requires PWA installation</1> for background push.

emergency.delete_desc: PERMANENTLY erase all data from servers. This action is irreversible.
emergency.logout_desc: This will log you out and clear your device data.

modals.sandbox_mode: You are currently in <1>Sandbox Mode</1>. Upgrade to remove messaging limits and unlock group creation.
modals.biometric_desc: Use Fingerprint or FaceID. Takes 1 second.
modals.pow_idle: Solve a cryptographic puzzle with your CPU. Takes 5-10 seconds.

sessions_page.title: Network Nodes
sessions_page.subtitle: Active Connections Monitor
sessions_page.link_button_hint: Add another device by scanning its QR
sessions_page.link_desc: Scan this code on the device you want to add. It works once and expires in 5 minutes.
sessions_page.link_manual_label: Or paste this link on the new device
sessions_page.link_pending_empty: No device is waiting to be linked.
sessions_page.link_offline: Not connected to the server. Try again in a moment.
sessions_page.link_qr_failed: Could not create a link code. Try again.
sessions_page.link_history_hint: Contacts, the conversation list and messages move to the new device. View-once media and read receipts are not transferred.
sessions_page.link_history_empty: Nothing to transfer yet — no contacts or chats.
sessions_page.link_history_uploaded: History archive ready — the new device will import it.
sessions_page.link_history_failed: Could not send the history archive. The device stays linked, without history.
sessions_page.link_history_too_large: The history archive is {{size}} MB, over your plan limit of {{limit}} MB. Nothing was uploaded — remove some media and link the device again.
sessions_page.history_retry_desc: The archive from your previous device is still available for a short time. Retrying continues where it stopped — anything already imported is not duplicated.
sessions_page.history_retry_done: {{count}} items restored from the previous device.
sessions_page.history_retry_expired: That archive is no longer available. Nothing was imported.
sessions_page.history_retry_failed: The history still could not be imported. The archive stays available for a short time.
sessions_page.link_single_device_note: Only one device stays active per account: the new device signs this one out once it finishes.

keys_page.title: Cryptographic Vault
keys_page.subtitle: End-to-End Encryption Protocol
keys_page.description: Your private keys are the only way to decrypt your messages. They are stored locally on this device. <1>Losing these keys means losing your message history forever.</1>
keys_page.recovery_desc: Reveal your 24-word seed phrase for backup.
keys_page.rotation_desc: Generates new identity keys. Old messages will become unreadable.
keys_page.confirm_rotation_desc: WARNING: DESTRUCTIVE ACTION. Previous message history will become undecryptable. This action is irreversible.

messages.biometric_scan_now: Scan fingerprint now to LOCK your vault...
messages.biometric_success: Biometric active! You can now login without password.
messages.biometric_enabled_not_verified: Biometric unlock is active, but this passkey is synced (Google/Apple account) so it does not prove a device. Uploads and broad user search stay locked until you add a device-bound authenticator or security key.
messages.mining_success: Proof Accepted! Account upgraded to VIP.
messages.emergency_failed: Failed to revoke remote sessions. Check your network connection.

privacy_status.title: Privacy self-check
privacy_status.subtitle: What is actually running on this device right now. Every row is labelled by its evidence, not by intent.
privacy_status.note: "Active" means there is real state on this device (for example a Key Transparency proof that passed verification). "Configured" means the path is enabled but no round-trip has been recorded here yet — we would rather say that than overstate the guarantee.
privacy_status.layer_e2ee_desc: Messages are sealed on the device; the server only relays ciphertext.
privacy_status.layer_ratchet_desc: Hybrid forward secrecy; v2 headers are only sent after the peer proves it can read them.
privacy_status.layer_ohttp_desc: Search requests are wrapped by a relay, so the API and edge do not see your IP.
privacy_status.layer_search_desc: Identifiers are searched through a blinded index; the server never receives them in the clear.
privacy_status.layer_kt_desc: Contact keys are checked against the public log, and the proof is verified on this device.
